We need to extract SMILES string efficiently. We have mass spec data: m/z 114.06808 etc. Likely molecular ion at 114.068. Need to infer formula. Use get_formula_from_smiles? We don't have SMILES yet. Could use mass to guess formula. 114.068 corresponds to C7H10O? Let's calculate: C7H10O = 7*12.0000 +10*1.007825 +15.994915 = 84 +10.07825+15.9949=110.07315. Not 114.068. C6H12O2 = 72+12.0939+31.9898=116.0837. C5H6O3 = 60+6.04695+47.9847=114.03165. Slight off. C5H6O3 exact mass: C5=60, H6=6.04695, O3=47.984745 =114.031695. Observed 114.06808, difference 0.0364. Maybe C6H10O2: 72+10.07825+31.9898=114.06805! Yes C6H10O2 exact mass = 72 +10.07825 +31.9898 =114.06805. That matches. So formula C6H10O2. DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 =6 -10/2 +1 =6-5+1=2. So two degrees unsaturation. Could be a carboxylic acid (C=O + OH) plus a double bond. Possibly methyl acrylate? Methyl acrylate formula C4H6O2? That's 86. Not. C6H10O2 could be hexenoic acid (C5H9-COOH). Example: 4-hexenoic acid (CH2=CH-CH2-CH2-COOH) formula C6H10O2. SMILES: C=CCCC(=O)O? Actually 4-hexenoic acid: C=CCCC(=O)O (double bond at start). That's "C=CCCC(=O)O". Another is 2-hexenoic acid: "C/C=C/CCCC(=O)O"? Wait 2-hexenoic acid: CH3-CH=CH-CH2-CH2-COOH => "CC=CCC(=O)O". Many isomers.

We need to extract SMILES from sample. Could use NMR data to pinpoint. Let's get proton NMR.
